no_other_game_regressed.result: CORRECTED (review finding, 2026-07-30). The earlier claim -- '11 of 12 games are IDENTICAL on every recorded field' -- was FALSE. The sweep compared three SUMMARY fields (total_actions, levels_gained, actions_to_first_solve) and never hashed the action trace, even though every cell recorded one. Hashing them: 8 of 12 games have a DIVERGENT action trace between scorer-on and scorer-off (vc33, tn36, tr87, cd82, tu93, ls20, cn04, r11l), of which 7 (tn36, tr87, cd82, tu93, ls20, cn04, r11l) are trace-divergent while all three summary metrics tie -- exactly the cells the old comparison could not see. Only ft09, sc25, su15 and lp85 are genuinely byte-identical.
no_other_game_regressed.termination_bound_not_the_budget: CORRECTED (review finding). Described earlier as 'budget 40'. The budget was passed as 40, but no cell reached it: every non-vc33 cell terminates at 25-26 total_actions and vc33 at 15-17, bounded by explore_budget / the max_inductions=1 cap, not by 40. The stated search depth was larger than what was performed.
no_other_game_regressed.what_this_means: The correct statement is: identical on SUMMARY METRICS for 11 of 12; identical on the ACTION TRACE for only 4 of 12. So the scorer's efficiency cost on tn36/tr87/cd82/tu93/ls20/cn04/r11l is UNMEASURED, not zero -- none of them reaches a first solve inside the run, so there is no actions_to_first_solve to compare, but their behaviour demonstrably differs. This STRENGTHENS the finding rather than weakening it: the asset axis perturbs the action stream on 8 of 12 games, which is why it was able to reproduce the pre-flight's divergence on the flagged cells. What it costs is the earlier 'bounded to one game' framing, which rested on the false identity.

the_half_that_is_real_and_commit_caused.correction: ADDED ON REVIEW. The earlier headline said 'there is no regression in the commit span to revert' and closed G3 with 'the vc33 cost disproved, nothing to weigh it against'. That over-reached: only the ACTIONS half of the reported regression was shown to be a confound. The pre-flight ALSO recorded, for vc33, a lost plan and two extra LLM refinement rounds, and that half was never re-tested path-controlled while the offline gate replay that explains it IS path-independent. The tradeoff was therefore not dissolved; it was left unstated.

NOT_established: the MAGNITUDE. The 3.12x wall and the 1 -> 3 refinement rounds were measured in the confounded probe, where the arms also differed by repo path; neither was re-measured path-controlled (doing so needs live LLM refinement rounds, not the offline replay).

the p3 probe's own mechanism. Its base arm (the source of the 10 -> 15 headline) recorded satisfiable=true / plan_length=1, but its PERSISTED predicate (sha b8688e5b0716) is degenerate_goal_predicate under ALL THREE gate revisions INCLUDING its own -- so the recorded verdict is not explained by the artifact that was stored. See predicate_provenance_and_the_unexplained_residual.

that the induced predicate is a pure function of the commit. The prompt TEXT change is commit-caused, but the transitions shown to the inducer are influenced by the scorer, which is the path/asset axis -- so the induced predicate is jointly determined.
what_is_established_and_what_is_not.commit_caused_path_independently: the GATE-side change. Replaying a FIXED captured predicate through each commit's _goal_satisfiability_check involves no repo-path channel at all, and the p2 probe's root-true predicate (sha 1b5a7cf4bc3a) is called satisfiable by the aa8a38e31 gate and rejected goal_predicate_true_at_root by both f9a458e87 and HEAD. Same input, different commit, different verdict.

the_half_that_is_real_and_commit_caused.why_it_is_still_not_a_revert: recovering vc33's length-1 plan means re-admitting a predicate that is true at the root (the p2 base arm's is a literal `return True`). That is the lower-the-bar anti-pattern the operator ruled out. The honest description is a TRADEOFF that was paid, not a bug to fix: a stricter goal gate cost a real in-production plan on vc33 and bought a gate pass on ka59 that is not affordable at the shipped budget.

the_question: The operator directed: 'revert the vc33 regression' -- a reproducible actions_to_first_solve 10 -> 15 on ARC game vc33, attributed by a pre-flight to commit f9a458e87 across six runs, two probes and two seeds.

the_real_finding_which_is_NOT_a_regressi.claim: the live action-effect scorer costs +5 actions to first solve on vc33 (10 -> 15). Under the competition's (baseline_actions/agent_actions)^2 term that is roughly a 56% score reduction on that level, and vc33 banks 2 levels -- the most of any cell in the probe corpus.
the_real_finding_which_is_NOT_a_regressi.not_claimed: that the scorer is net-negative overall. Its graduation was measured on first-win rate and action efficiency across a corpus; this artifact measures ONE game at ONE seed. A corpus sweep (12 games, budget 40, same LLM-free harness) found no OTHER game whose numbers move at all between scorer-on and scorer-off -- every other cell was identical and reached no first solve inside the budget -- so this evidence bounds the effect rather than generalising it.
the_real_finding_which_is_NOT_a_regressi.status: PRE-EXISTING production behaviour since at least 2026-06-23, not introduced by any commit under test. It is a real lever worth investigating on its own terms; it is not something to revert.

title: The vc33 'goal-predicate regression' is a repo-path confound: two untracked live assets, not any commit

what_the_pre_flight_measured_and_why_six.the_design_flaw: every base/pre arm ran from a /tmp git worktree and every head/post arm from the canonical checkout. The A/A noise controls were each taken WITHIN their own arm's repo, so they measured sampler noise and never the path channel. Six zero-variance replicates therefore replicate the confound exactly as faithfully as they replicate the treatment.

what_was_NOT_done_and_why.G3_budget_unit_left_alone: SUPERSEDED ON REVIEW -- see the_half_that_is_real_and_commit_caused.G3_reopened. The earlier reason ('the vc33 cost is disproved, so there is nothing to weigh it against') rested on a premise that is now withdrawn for the plan/refinement half. G3 is still not taken, but for the remaining reason only: changing a budget UNIT to make a gate pass is the same lower-the-bar class, and it is verdict-neutral for vc33.
what_was_NOT_done_and_why.no_revert_of_f9a458e87: its premise is disproved. Reverting it would remove five input-side corrections (including the ones that un-killed GOAL-REPAIR and stopped correct predicates being penalised in three places) to fix a regression that commit did not cause.
what_was_NOT_done_and_why.no_widening_of_any_quality_gate: degenerate_goal_predicate, goal_predicate_true_at_root and min_heldout_accuracy are untouched. The operator's rule against recovering vc33 by lowering a bar was never reached, because vc33's number is not produced by any gate.
